name: Sina Mail
description: Search mail, save drafts, send replies and handle attachments in personal sina.com and sina.cn mailboxes.
examples: Find unread mail in my Sina inbox from the last seven days.
Draft a reply to the latest project email and save it in my mailbox without sending.
List the attachments on this email and download the PDF I select to my session folder.

zh-CN.name: 新浪邮箱
zh-CN.description: 查询个人 sina.com、sina.cn 邮件，保存草稿、发送回复和处理附件。
examples: 查找新浪收件箱最近七天的未读邮件。
为最新的项目邮件起草回复，保存到邮箱草稿箱。
列出这封邮件的附件，将选定的 PDF 下载到会话目录。
